headline: The shopper chat is lean (about 5,000 characters a call); the AI manager is the heavy part: about 161,700 characters a call (roughly 40,400 tokens, an estimate), 91% of it 124 tool definitions that do not depend on the question, on up to 11 calls a turn. A lean default drawn with the app's own functions is 48,600 characters on Home and 77,000 on an orders page; it is already code review step 3.18 (Open), and the eval meant to guard it does not test whether the model finds a tool (9 manager cases, none uses load_tools), so that check comes first. Around the AI, screens, polls and five-minute jobs fetch the AI connection and walk every site before knowing there is work (237,563 connection reads against 19,104 AI calls): small today, rising with every store, clearest in the alt-text job. The one quick, safe win is in the browser: the chat's script is 496 KB, of which about 370 KB (estimate) is the model's tool catalogue and admin map.

findings.title: Every AI manager call sends 124 tool definitions, whatever the question or screen
findings.saving: Round 161,700 -> 48,600 chars on Home (-70%), 77,000 on orders (-52%), about 100,000 on products/settings (-36%); -36 to -41% a turn with a load round

findings.title: The AI connection is fetched, key and month's cost included, by screens and polls that only draw a button
findings.saving: Open support conversation: 4-30 provider reads a minute -> at most 1; builder page 3 -> 1. Seconds of DB time a day now; stops growing per owner

findings.title: Nothing asks for prompt caching or measures it, and the store is charged the full price either way
findings.saving: Not measured. After AI-1 about 48,000 stable chars a round could be cached from round 2; allowance then counted at the cached price

findings.title: The owner's browser downloads the model's whole tool catalogue and admin map
findings.saving: About 370 KB raw of 496 KB (estimate from analyzer module sizes), roughly 100 KB of 144 KB gzip; measured floor 259 KB

findings.title: The knowledge, product and picture index jobs rescan per store to find nothing
findings.saving: Product scan 12x less often; knowledge and picture jobs fall to one small query when idle. About 6 s of DB time a day now; stops growing per store

findings.title: The autopilot's, follow-ups' and saved-skills' tools ride on every AI manager round
findings.saving: 15,384 characters a round (about 3,800 tokens, estimate) when the group is not loaded; none if the owner keeps them always present

findings.title: One text model does every job, small ones included
findings.saving: Not measured: the price gap between two models times the small jobs' tokens; small while the main model is gpt-5-mini

findings.title: Tool schemas say more than the model needs
findings.saving: After AI-1: 4,000-7,700 chars a round of string bounds, up to 1,610 of gate sentences; product tool split up to about 10,000 on product pages

findings.title: A turn does needless work before the first model call
findings.saving: One embeddings call a turn for a person with 8 or fewer memories; a whole-conversation read becomes one row. Latency gain not measured

findings.title: Nothing limits how large an AI call may grow
findings.saving: No direct saving: stops regrowth after AI-1, AI-6, AI-8 and gives their checks a number (about 1,100 chars per new tool today, unseen)

findings.title: The prompt lists every playbook and the admin map, whatever the store or the kind of turn
findings.saving: Up to about 3,000 chars a round for a website with no shop; 2,700-6,400 a round in autopilot and Dream Factory turns; near nothing for a shop owner

findings.title: Every open admin tab asks for AI manager notices once a minute
findings.saving: With AD-9's back-off about two thirds of 60 calls an hour per idle owner tab, and half the statements per call

findings.title: The alt-text job walks every site that has an AI-written alt text, every five minutes, and retries a failed picture every day with no end
findings.saving: Idle run: 2+ round trips per site with pictures -> one query in all; daily vision retries stop after five tries instead of never

findings.title: The agents' eval cannot tell whether the model finds a tool, so the default tool set cannot be lowered safely
findings.saving: None by itself: unlocks AI-1 (-36% to -70% a round), AI-6 and AI-8 and keeps them from being undone unnoticed
